import copy,json
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from experiments import openexempt_online as online
from legal_skill_guard.inference.codex_cli_client import CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT,render_structured_codex_prompt
root=Path.cwd();cfg=json.loads((root/'configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json').read_text())
rows=json.loads((root/cfg['input_packet']).read_text())['rows']
p=root/'runs'/cfg['run_id']
pubs=[json.loads((p/f'publications/b{b}.json').read_text()) for b in range(1,9)]
cache={};empties=[];frozen=[]
for b in range(1,9):
 records=json.loads((p/f'batches/b{b}_prequential_records.json').read_text())
 empties.extend(records['empty']);frozen.extend(records['frozen_initial'])
 for collection in records.values():
  for r in collection:cache[(r['bank_sha256'],r['case_id'],r['family'])]=r
 for d in pubs[b-1]['training_decisions']:
  for key in ['actual_replay','proposed_replay']:
   for r in d.get(key,[]):cache[(r['bank_sha256'],r['case_id'],r['family'])]=r
checks=[]
for wirefile in sorted((p/'teacher').glob('*/wire_request.json')):
 wire=json.loads(wirefile.read_text());old=json.loads(wire['user_prompt'])
 parent_hash=online.csha(old['current_parent_library'])
 observations={(cid,f):r for (h,cid,f),r in cache.items() if h==parent_hash}
 seen_ids=set(old['training_evidence_manifest']['all_seen_source_ids'])
 current_ids=set(old['current_source_case_ids'])
 seen=[r for r in rows if r['case_id'] in seen_ids];current=[r for r in seen if r['case_id'] in current_ids]
 feedback=[]
 for item in old['rejected_candidate_feedback']:
  origin=item['candidate_feedback_origin']
  q=pubs[origin['batch']-1]['training_decisions'][origin['attempt']-1]
  h=origin.get('current_committed_bank_sha256',origin.get('publication_bank_sha256'))
  reference={(cid,f):r for (bank,cid,f),r in cache.items() if bank==h}
  feedback.append(online.candidate_feedback(q,reference,origin))
 study=online.Online.__new__(online.Online)
 study.cfg={**cfg,'skill_commit_policy':'adaptive_legal','adaptive_commit_objective':'seen_source_min_family_gain_then_mean_v1'}
 study.bank=copy.deepcopy(old['current_parent_library'])
 study.meter=SimpleNamespace(token_count=lambda **kw:old['full_serialized_library_token_budget']['actual_parent_tokens'])
 study.prequential_empty,study.prequential_frozen=empties,frozen
 body=study.teacher_body(current,seen,observations,feedback)
 intended=sum(len(f.get('feedback_witness_replay',[])) for f in feedback)
 supplied=sum(len(f.get('feedback_witness_replay',[])) for f in body['rejected_candidate_feedback'])
 assert intended==supplied
 user=json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
 length=len(render_structured_codex_prompt(online.DIRECT_AUTHOR_SYSTEM+online.CANDIDATE_FEEDBACK_ADDITION,user))
 assert length<=CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT
 checks.append({'historical_attempt':wirefile.parent.name,'old_prompt_characters':len(wire['user_prompt']),'revised_rendered_prompt_characters':length,'new_selected_sources':len(body['training_evidence_manifest']['selected_source_ids']),'all_bounded_witness_tasks':intended,'delivered_witness_tasks':supplied,'all_current_sources_kept':set(body['training_evidence_manifest']['current_source_ids_all_included'])==current_ids,'all_sources_already_seen_TRAIN':set(body['training_evidence_manifest']['selected_source_ids'])<=seen_ids,'no_grader_model_teacher_or_tokenizer_call':True,'parent_token_count_receipt':'Reuse exact recorded parent-tokenizer count for this unchanged historical parent; only packet characters assessed here'})
print(json.dumps({'classification':'Historical main TRAIN teacher-packet reconstruction only; no live teacher/native/grader/tokenizer calls','all15_packets_with_zero_witness_omissions':len(checks)==15,'transport_character_limit':CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT,'maximum_revised_rendered_characters':max(c['revised_rendered_prompt_characters'] for c in checks),'checks':checks},ensure_ascii=False))
